concerns.text: The plan uses the accuracy drop (ΔAcc = Acc_orig - Acc_swapped) as a primary evidence of motion‑reliance, yet the Counterfactual Consistency (CC) loss directly penalises prediction changes between original and counterfactual pairs. Because ΔAcc is computed from the same predictions that the loss optimises, the validation target is not independent of the predictor, making the evaluation circular and the claimed improvement trivially guaranteed by the loss definition.
